description: Defines the DocumentResponse class, which implements JsonSerializable to structure JSON API responses including data, meta, and links.

classes.name: DocumentResponse
classes.description: A class representing a JSON API document response, including data, meta, and links, and implementing custom JSON serialization.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data payload, which can be an array or a single DataResponse or array of DataResponse objects.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data payload for the response.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves the meta information of the response.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the meta information object for the response.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves the links associated with the response.

methods.name: setLinks
methods.description: Sets the links object for the response.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the response object into an array suitable for JSON encoding, including conditional addition of meta and links.
